analysis.title: GS Blekos - US Equity 2027 Outlook / Nvidia / Whitbread / Prysmian / Europe Indus Barometer / Puig / Neste / Dassault / Abu Dhabi Bank, 18 Nov 2026
key_insights: Goldman forecasts the S&P 500 rises 17% to 8,700 by year-end 2027. EPS growth is expected to slow from roughly 30% in 2026 to 18% in 2027, driven by earnings, a solid economy and continued AI investment.
The S&P 500 forward P/E fell 19% in 2026 and sits near its 10-year average. Goldman expects rates and AI uncertainty to keep the P/E near 18x.

2027 themes: AI Productivity Candidates (Exhibit 50), Buyback Aristocrats (Exhibit 51), Energy Infra, Transport, Healthcare (biopharma, managed care), and selected Staples (beauty, energy drinks, nicotine).

Nvidia: Goldman expects the stock to hold its gains after a solid quarter with CY27 guidance raised ahead of Street expectations. Investor positioning is described as neutral-to-negative, per Goldman's conversations with investors.

Goldman believes Nvidia management's commentary should bolster investor confidence in the fundamentals of Nvidia and the broader AI ecosystem, though significant uncertainty remains on several fronts.

Whitbread (WTB.L) upgraded to Buy with a 12-month price target of 3,700p, about 32% upside. Goldman argues earnings, returns on capital and shareholder returns will improve sooner and more steeply than the market expects, while the shares trade near their trough multiple of the last 10+ years.

Prysmian (PRY.MI): Buy reiterated after 3Q26. FY26-28E adj. EBITDA raised by about 3%-2% on the 3Q26 beat and a higher 4Q26 barometer. Goldman sees 2026 EBITDA above the top end of guidance and expects 2027 adj. EBITDA guidance above €4bn at full-year results.
Prysmian's drivers are mix improvements from the Transmission backlog and better Digital Solutions margins from fiber price tailwinds and higher volumes from Channell (40% EBITDA margins).

Europe Multi-Industry: US Capital Goods PPI slowed sequentially in October, in line with Iran conflict developments and improved tanker traffic, but stays 2.7 pp above its 20-year median. China October PPI rose 0.7 pp sequentially versus September.

Europe September PPI accelerated sequentially and stays 2.5 pp above the historical median. The note maps raw material moves to product categories and gives company-level correlations in the Appendix.
Puig Brands (PUIGb.MC) is reportedly in final talks to acquire Parfums de Marly.
Neste (NESTE.HE): Buy reiterated on volume growth, strong free cash flow generation and an undemanding valuation.

Dassault Systemes (DAST.PA), 2026 Capital Markets Day: Goldman says any re-rating depends on sales execution and delivery on the path to double-digit revenue growth. Investor focus stays on sales execution, the AI product rollout and proof of AI monetization.
Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB.AD) upgraded to Buy as well positioned to capitalize on growth.
